description: This file is a Java utility class named DatabaseUtil, providing static methods for executing SQL queries, loading database drivers, and retrieving unique column values in the context of the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: DatabaseUtil
classes.description: A utility class that provides static methods for database-related operations such as executing SQL queries, loading database drivers, and retrieving distinct non-null column values within the OpenMRS project.

methods.name: loadDatabaseDriver
methods.description: Loads the appropriate database driver class based on the connection URL and driver name, and returns the driver class name.

methods.name: executeSQL
methods.description: Executes a given SQL query on a Hibernate Session or JDBC Connection, with an option to enforce select-only queries.

methods.name: checkQueryForManipulationCommands
methods.description: Checks if a SQL string contains data manipulation commands; throws an exception if selectOnly is true and such commands are found.

methods.name: populateResultsFromSQLQuery
methods.description: Executes the SQL statement and populates the results list with query output or update count.

methods.name: getUniqueNonNullColumnValues
methods.description: Retrieves all distinct, non-null values from a specified column in a table.
